compiled_state.title: T2 GREEN: Implement counter helpers, escalation emitter, and dispatch budget-pressure
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## What
Implement the functions required to pass the T1 RED tests. All T1 RED markers must be removed from .test-index after this task.

### 1. In plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh

Add two new state helpers following the atomic write-to-temp-then-rename pattern:
- _state_write_remediation_state(phase, attempts_per_tier_json, attempts_global): writes remediation_phase, remediation_attempts_per_tier, remediation_attempts_global to state file atomically
- _state_read_remediation_state(): reads all three fields, outputs KEY=VALUE lines; defaults: phase='', per_tier='{}', global=0

### 2. In plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh

Add two new functions before _phase_remediate:
- _remediate_counter_increment(tier, t1_count, t2_count, t3_count, t4_count, global_count): per-tier ceiling 5, global ceiling 15; returns empty=continue, TIER_CEILING, GLOBAL_CEILING, or REGRESSION:N signal
- _remediate_emit_escalation(stop_reason, tiers_attempted_csv, attempts_per_tier_json, remaining_findings_path, suggested_next_step): emits escalation JSON with all 7 stop_reason values: TIER_CEILING, GLOBAL_CEILING, CANNOT_PROCEED, OSCILLATION, THROTTLE_PAUSE, CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_FAILED, ARTIFACT_MISSING

Extend _dispatch_fix_agent() with optional second arg _attempt_num:
- When _attempt_num == 4: append budget-pressure text to LLM prompt: 'This is attempt 4 of 5 - if you cannot resolve this finding, return ESCALATE with a clear explanation'
- Other values: no budget-pressure appended

### 3. Remove T1 RED markers from .test-index

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- .test-index

## Acceptance criteria
- must: all T1 RED test functions now pass
- must: all T1 RED markers removed from .test-index
- must: no existing tests broken
- must: _state_write_remediation_state uses atomic write pattern (write .tmp then rename)
